7684-7690-7818.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
7684-7690-7818.description:
Gain life.
Tigra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

206-339-574-677.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
206-339-574-677.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

240-955-5470-8250.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Repeat from step 2.

3755-4770-6090-7297.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1563-4321-5777-7824.description:
Activate Camellia by paying {2} and sacrificing a Food.
Camellia's first ability triggers, creating two Foods and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Resolve the Camellia ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Squirrel you control.
Activate the two Foods by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

1580-2438-4556-4871.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

129-206-1409-6006.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

3129-5660-6462-6753-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

2173-2448-5220-7452.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2173-2448-5220-7452.description:
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mortuary and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Firestarter ability.
Cast Goblin Firestarter from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

4038-5963-7221.notablePrerequisites: There's an Elf card in your graveyard.

1308-1409-5421.description:
Activate Redcap Thief by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Redcap Thief enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Redcap Thief.
Resolve the Redcap Thief trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

1434-4116-7009.manaNeeded: {1} plus an additional {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
1434-4116-7009.description:
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Avatar Kuruk until your next turn.
Activate Volrath by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

132-2816-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
132-2816-7013.description:
Activate Myr Welder using White Lotus Tile's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Myr Welder by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

4474-5051-5078-6918.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

527-542-1849.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
527-542-1849.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4050-4435-4550-5567--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4050-4435-4550-5567--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

1018-4067-5116-6281.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Skullwinder.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Skullwinder that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Skullwinder token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Skullwinder from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

1477-2018-5570.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Nardole.
When Nardole dies, its undying ability triggers if it didn't have a +1/+1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Nardole didn't have flying.
Resolve the undying trigger, if applicable, returning Nardole from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Nardole from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

3156-4242-4763-4955.description:
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Su-Chi.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk by sacrificing Su-Chi, targeting Koll.
When Su-Chi dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Koll.
Cast Su-Chi by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-394-4798-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
392-394-4798-5686.description:
Activate Harnfel by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil, causing you to exile the top two cards of your library with the ability to play them this turn.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
When the Blood enters the battlefield, Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning Ovalchase Daredevil from your graveyard to your hand.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a 1/1 Bat creature token.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature with MV<=3 that has "When ~ enters, you get at least {E}"

678-5231-5674--40.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least {E}.
You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using {R}.
678-5231-5674--40.description:
Cast the creature that causes you to get energy counter(s) when it enters the battlefield by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers.
When the creature enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get at least {E}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the creature, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2051-2546-3178-3872.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two additional land cards in hand.
2051-2546-3178-3872.description:
Activate Forgotten Cave's cycling ability by paying {R} and discarding it.
 Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Forgotten Cave ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Land's Edge by discarding a land card.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Land's Edge ability, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate the three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}{G}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning Forgotten Cave and two other lands from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1274-2060-3525-5162.notablePrerequisites:
Kwain does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Kwain.
1274-2060-3525-5162.description:
Activate Kwain by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life, and allowing each opponent to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Kwain.
Repeat.

1434-3129-3649-3851-4772.notablePrerequisites:
Blade of Selves attached to Etrata.
Etrata does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent owns at least two cards in exile with hit counters on them.
Each opponent controls at least three nontoken creatures, minus one for each card they own in exile with a hit counter on it.
1434-3129-3649-3851-4772.description:
Declare Etrata as an attacker, attacking an opponent that owns at least two cards in exile with hit counters on them.
Etrata's myriad ability triggers, creating four copies of it attacking each other opponent.
Deal combat damage with each Etrata, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the first Etrata ability, causing the opponent dealt damage by it to exile a creature they control with a hit counter on it, and lose the game if they have at least three cards in exile with hit counters on them.
Repeat step 4  for each remaining trigger.

248-2034-3362.manaNeeded: {3}{B}{B}{R}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
248-2034-3362.description:
Cast Bladewing either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B}{B}{R}{R} and commander tax, if applicable.
Bladewing enters the battlefield, returning Changeling Berserker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Changeling Berserker enters the battlefield, championing Bladewing.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Changeling Berserker, adding {C}{C}.
Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield, returning Bladewing from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1283-2034-2440-3705.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
1283-2034-2440-3705.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {3}.
Squee enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding at least {C}{C}.
Repeat.

618-4242-4499-4659.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping itself, creating a token copy of Su-Chi.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing copy of Su-Chi, adding {C}{C}.
Su-Chi triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

3407-5026.manaNeeded: {R}{R}{R}, plus an additional {R} if Dual Strike was not foretold, plus enough mana to cast the additional spell if needed
3407-5026.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cast an additional instant or sorcery, or an opponent is casting one.
3407-5026.description:
Cast any other instant and/or sorcery spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, cast Dual Strike by paying {R}{R}, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast with mana value four or less.
Cast Reverberate by paying {R}{R}, targeting the instant or sorcery spell cast in step 1.
Dual Strike triggers, copying Reverberate, with the copy targeting the original Reverberate.
Resolve the copy of Reverberate, copying Reverberate, with the copy targeting the original Reverberate.
Repeat step 5.

2977-4050-4053.description:
Sacrifice Bogardan Phoenix to Phyrexian Altar for one mana of any color.
Bogardan Phoenix returns from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
